description: This line plot illustrates the loss evolution over training iterations for five different model configurations, with the y-axis representing “Loss” on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, and the x-axis representing “#Iteration” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000. The legend identifies five distinct lines: “Vanilla” (purple, solid line), “StrmLLM (n=64)” (blue, solid line), “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange, solid line), “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green, solid line), and “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” (red, solid line), along with “SepLLM (n=128)” (dark blue, solid line). All lines begin at a loss value of approximately 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a gradual flattening toward a final loss value of approximately 2.5 after 140,000 iterations. The “Vanilla” line starts at 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. The “StrmLLM (n=64)” line starts at 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.6. The “SepLLM (n=64)” line starts at 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” line starts at 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” line starts at 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. The “SepLLM (n=128)” line starts at 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. All lines show a consistent downward trend with no significant peaks or plateaus other than the gradual flattening at the end of training.
